# Gerti Foods

> B2B factory in Prizren, Kosovo supplying bakeries, hotels, restaurants, supermarkets, catering and distributors with ISO 22000 certified half-baked (par-baked) products — byrek (pies) and tortillas — that finish baking fresh in 15 to 20 minutes.

Gerti Foods is a wholesale producer of half-baked (par-baked) bakery products, founded in January 2024 in Prizren, Kosovo by three partners from the Hasi region, home to more than 600 years of bread-baking tradition. Products arrive frozen and finish baking on-site in 15 to 20 minutes, so a buyer serves oven-fresh product with the same quality on every shift and no in-house baker. The factory combines that heritage with automated European production lines and is certified to HACCP, ISO 22000, IFS, BRC and Halal standards. The company sells B2B only (no consumer retail) and ships across Kosovo, Albania, Hungary, Croatia, Slovakia and Germany.

Production capacity: tortillas up to 3,000 pcs/hour, byrek up to 800 pcs/hour.

## Products

- [Products catalog](https://gertifoods.com/products): full searchable product list with prices and minimum order quantities. All byrek are half-baked and delivered frozen, finish in 15–20 minutes, and have a minimum order of 50 pieces; up to 800 pcs/hour.
- [Cheese byrek](https://gertifoods.com/products/pite-me-djathe): traditional flaky pastry filled with white cheese.
- [Spinach byrek with cheese](https://gertifoods.com/products/pite-me-spinaq): traditional flaky pastry filled with spinach and cheese.
- [Meat byrek](https://gertifoods.com/products/pite-me-mish): traditional flaky pastry filled with seasoned minced meat.
- [Tuna byrek](https://gertifoods.com/products/pite-me-tuna): traditional flaky pastry filled with tuna.
- [Mixed byrek family pack](https://gertifoods.com/products/family-pack-pite-4): all four byrek varieties in one retail-ready pack.
- [Wholesale tortillas](https://gertifoods.com/products/tortilla): fresh tortillas in four variants — plain, vegetable, fruit and cinnamon — for bakeries, hotels and restaurants. Up to 3,000 pcs/hour.

## Customers Served

- Bakeries: byrek and tortillas ready to bake — no dough, no in-house baker.
- Hotels & restaurants (HORECA): byrek and tortillas in about 20 minutes, a premium menu without a baker on shift.
- Supermarkets & retail: shelf-appeal packaging, fast turnover, higher margin.
- Catering: industrial volumes with on-time delivery and consistent quality per event.

## Areas Served

- [Kosovo](https://gertifoods.com/areas/kosovo): home market. Delivered on the company's own truck within 24–48 hours of order confirmation, on request rather than a fixed schedule; minimum order one pallet.
- [Albania](https://gertifoods.com/areas/albania): delivered on the company's own truck within a week of order confirmation, on request rather than a fixed schedule.
- [Hungary](https://gertifoods.com/areas/hungary)
- [Croatia](https://gertifoods.com/areas/croatia)
- [Slovakia](https://gertifoods.com/areas/slovakia)
- [Germany](https://gertifoods.com/areas/germany)

## Agent Tools Available

This site registers WebMCP tools (see [WebMCP documentation](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/ai/webmcp)):

- search_products: search the product catalog by keyword and return up to ten matching products with name, page URL, price and description.
- get_contact_info: return the company's phone, WhatsApp, email and address so a buyer can reach the sales team.
- search_products_form: declarative search form that loads the product results page for a keyword.
